what: Toolbar hotkey-badge-over-label overlap review found by eye (reproduced on 10 of 20 toolbar buttons, obscuring the value on 'Harvest 3' and 'ration 0'). Fix: fold the hotkey into the button's own label text for buttons that already show one (ShowsHotkeyAsCornerBadge), keep the corner badge only for the ten icon-only buttons. New standing check: AssertToolbarHotkeysDoNotOverlapLabels (src/DungeonFortress.Game/Main.Hud.cs), called from AssertControlStripsFit, which already runs from every existing entry point in Main.cs.
method: Mutant applied to the tracked file with sed after the checked state was committed (b64ad50), godot stage run, output captured, then `git checkout -- src/DungeonFortress.Game/Main.Hud.cs` to revert.

beforeFixScreenshot.capturedFrom: commit 335dc6b (the branch tip review examined), frame 1600x900 — the resolution review reproduced the defect on
beforeFixScreenshot.visibleDefect: 0.5x/1x/4x/16x show the speed suffix with the hotkey digit overlapping the trailing 'x'; BASE/NEGLECT/REPLAY show the trailing letter overlapping; Farm/Harvest 3/ration 0 show the hotkey letter overlapping the trailing character — for Harvest 3 and ration 0 that trailing character is the value digit itself (3, 0), fully obscured.

afterFixScreenshot.note: Same frame and camera as evidence/352-toolbar-before.png.
afterFixScreenshot.visibleFix: Every previously-overlapping button now reads its label followed by its hotkey in brackets — '0.5x [1]', 'BASE [R]', 'Farm [Z]', 'Harvest 3 [J]', 'ration 0 [K]' — with no overlap and both digits fully readable.
